companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Array of {country, id}. country: NO, DK, FI, CH, PL, CZ, BE, SK or FR. id: NO orgnr (9 digits), DK CVR (8), FI Y-tunnus (1234567-8), CH UID (CHE-123.456.789), PL KRS (10) or NIP, CZ IČO (8), BE enterprise number (0403.170.701), SK IČO (8), FR SIREN (9) or SIRET (14). Strings like "DK:24256790" also work.
